passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.1
passages.text: Pone metum! nihil hic iterum iurabis amanti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.2
passages.text: Promissam satis est te semel esse mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.3
passages.text: Perlege! discedat sic corpore languor ab isto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.4
passages.text: Quod meus est ulla parte dolere dolor!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.5
passages.text: Quid pudor ante subit? nam, sicut in aede Dianae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.6
passages.text: Suspicor ingenuas erubuisse genas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.7
passages.text: Coniugium pactamque fidem, non crimina posco;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.8
passages.text: Debitus ut coniunx, non ut adulter amo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.9
passages.text: Verba licet repetas, quae demptus ab arbore fetus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.10
passages.text: Pertulit ad castas me iaciente manus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.11
passages.text: Invenies illic, id te spondere, quod opto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.12
passages.text: Te potius, virgo, quam meminisse deam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.13
passages.text: Nunc quoque avemus idem, sed idem tamen acrius illud;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.14
passages.text: Adsumpsit vires auctaque flamma mora est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.15
passages.text: Quique fuit numquam parvus, nunc tempore longo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.16
passages.text: Et spe, quam dederas tu mihi, crevit amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.17
passages.text: Spem mihi tu dederas, meus hic tibi credidit ardor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.18
passages.text: Non potes hoc factum teste negare dea.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.19
passages.text: Adfuit et, praesens ut erat, tua verba notavit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.20
passages.text: Et visa est mota dicta tulisse coma.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.21
passages.text: Deceptam dicas nostra te fraude licebit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.22
passages.text: Dum fraudis nostrae causa feratur amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.23
passages.text: Fraus mea quid petiit, nisi uti tibi iungerer, unum?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.24
passages.text: Id te, quod quereris, conciliare potest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.25
passages.text: Non ego natura nec sum tam callidus usu;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.26
passages.text: Sollertem tu me, crede, puella, facis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.27
passages.text: Te mihi conpositis — siquid tamen egimus — a me

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.28
passages.text: Adstrinxit verbis ingeniosus Amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.29
passages.text: Dictatis ab eo feci sponsalia verbis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.30
passages.text: Consultoque fui iuris Amore vafer.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.31
passages.text: Sit fraus huic facto nomen, dicarque dolosus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.32
passages.text: Si tamen est, quod ames, velle tenere dolus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.33
passages.text: En, iterum scribo mittoque rogantia verba!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.34
passages.text: Altera fraus haec est, quodque queraris habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.35
passages.text: Si noceo, quod amo, fateor, sine fine nocebo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.36
passages.text: Teque, peti caveas tu licet, usque petam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.37
passages.text: Per gladios alii placitas rapuere puellas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.38
passages.text: Scripta mihi caute littera crimen erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.39
passages.text: Di faciant, possim plures inponere nodos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.40
passages.text: Ut tua sit nulla libera parte fides!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.41
passages.text: Mille doli restant — clivo sudamus in imo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.42
passages.text: Ardor inexpertum nil sinet esse meus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.43
passages.text: Sit dubium, possisne capi; captabere certe.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.44
passages.text: Exitus in dis est, sed capiere tamen.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.45
passages.text: Ut partem effugias, non omnia retia falles,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.46
passages.text: Quae tibi, quam credis, plura tetendit Amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.47
passages.text: Si non proficient artes, veniemus ad arma,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.48
passages.text: Inque tui cupido rapta ferere sinu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.49
passages.text: Non sum, qui soleam Paridis reprehendere factum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.50
passages.text: Nec quemquam, qui vir, posset ut esse, fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.51
passages.text: Nos quoque — sed taceo! mors huius poena rapinae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.52
passages.text: Ut sit, erit, quam te non habuisse, minor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.53
passages.text: Aut esses formosa minus, peterere modeste;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.54
passages.text: Audaces facie cogimur esse tua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.55
passages.text: Tu facis hoc oculique tui, quibus ignea cedunt

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.56
passages.text: Sidera, qui flammae causa fuere meae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.57
passages.text: Hoc faciunt flavi crines et eburnea cervix,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.58
passages.text: Quaeque, precor, veniant in mea colla manus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.59
passages.text: Et decor et vultus sine rusticitate pudentes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.60
passages.text: Et, Thetidis qualis vix rear esse, pedes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.61
passages.text: Cetera si possem laudare, beatior essem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.62
passages.text: Nec dubito, totum quin sibi par sit opus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.63
passages.text: Hac ego conpulsus, non est mirabile, forma

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.64
passages.text: Si pignus volui vocis habere tuae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.65
passages.text: Denique, dum captam tu te cogare fateri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.66
passages.text: Insidiis esto capta puella meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.67
passages.text: Invidiam patiar; passo sua praemia dentur.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.68
passages.text: Cur suus a tanto crimine fructus abest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.69
passages.text: Hesionen Telamon, Briseida cepit Achilles;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.70
passages.text: Utraque victorem nempe secuta virum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.71
passages.text: Quamlibet accuses et sis irata licebit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.72
passages.text: Irata liceat dum mihi posse frui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.73
passages.text: Idem, qui facimus, factam tenuabimus iram,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.74
passages.text: Copia placandi sit modo parva tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.75
passages.text: Ante tuos liceat flentem consistere vultus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.76
passages.text: Et liceat lacrimis addere verba suis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.77
passages.text: Utque solent famuli, cum verbera saeva verentur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.78
passages.text: Tendere submissas ad tua crura manus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.79
passages.text: Ignoras tua iura; voca! cur arguor absens?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.80
passages.text: Iamdudum dominae more venire iube.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.81
passages.text: Ipsa meos scindas licet imperiosa capillos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.82
passages.text: Oraque sint digitis livida nostra tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.83
passages.text: Omnia perpetiar; tantum fortasse timebo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.84
passages.text: Corpore laedatur ne manus ista meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.85
passages.text: Sed neque conpedibus nec me conpesce catenis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.86
passages.text: Servabor firmo vinctus amore tui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.87
passages.text: Cum bene se quantumque voles satiaverit ira,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.88
passages.text: Ipsa tibi dices: 'quam patienter amat!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.89
passages.text: Ipsa tibi dices, ubi videris omnia ferri:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.90
passages.text: 'Tam bene qui servit, serviat iste mihi!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.91
passages.text: Nunc reus infelix absens agor, et mea, cum sit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.92
passages.text: Optima, non ullo causa tuente perit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.93
passages.text: Hoc quoque — quantumvis sit scriptum iniuria nostrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.94
passages.text: Quod de me solo, nempe, queraris, habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.95
passages.text: Non meruit falli mecum quoque Delia; si non

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.96
passages.text: Vis mihi promissum reddere, redde deae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.97
passages.text: Adfuit et vidit, cum tu decepta rubebas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.98
passages.text: Et vocem memori condidit aure tuam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.99
passages.text: Omina re careant! nihil est violentius illa,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.100
passages.text: Cum sua, quod nolim, numina laesa videt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.101
passages.text: Testis erit Calydonis aper, sic saevus, ut illo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.102
passages.text: Sit magis in natum saeva reperta parens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.103
passages.text: Testis et Actaeon, quondam fera creditus illis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.104
passages.text: Ipse dedit leto cum quibus ante feras;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.105
passages.text: Quaeque superba parens saxo per corpus oborto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.106
passages.text: Nunc quoque Mygdonia flebilis adstat humo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.107
passages.text: Ei mihi! Cydippe, timeo tibi dicere verum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.108
passages.text: Ne videar causa falsa monere mea;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.109
passages.text: Dicendum tamen est. hoc est, mihi crede, quod aegra

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.110
passages.text: Ipso nubendi tempore saepe iaces.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.111
passages.text: Consulit ipsa tibi, neu sis periura, laborat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.112
passages.text: Et salvam salva te cupit esse fide.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.113
passages.text: Inde fit ut, quotiens existere perfida temptas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.114
passages.text: Peccatum totiens corrigat illa tuum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.115
passages.text: Parce movere feros animosae virginis arcus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.116
passages.text: Mitis adhuc fieri, si patiare, potest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.117
passages.text: Parce, precor, teneros corrumpere febribus artus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.118
passages.text: Servetur facies ista fruenda mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.119
passages.text: Serventur vultus ad nostra incendia nati,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.120
passages.text: Quique subest niveo lenis in ore rubor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.121
passages.text: Hostibus et siquis, ne fias nostra, repugnat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.122
passages.text: Sic sit ut invalida te solet esse mihi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.123
passages.text: Torqueor ex aequo vel te nubente vel aegra

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.124
passages.text: Dicere nec possum, quid minus ipse velim;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.125
passages.text: Maceror interdum, quod sim tibi causa dolendi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.126
passages.text: Teque mea laedi calliditate puto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.127
passages.text: In caput ut nostrum dominae periuria quaeso

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.128
passages.text: Eveniant; poena tuta sit illa mea!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.129
passages.text: Ne tamen ignorem, quid agas, ad limina crebro

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.130
passages.text: Anxius huc illuc dissimulanter eo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.131
passages.text: Subsequor ancillam furtim famulumque, requirens

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.132
passages.text: Profuerint somni quid tibi quidve cibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.133
passages.text: Me miserum, quod non medicorum iussa ministro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.134
passages.text: Effingoque manus, adsideoque toro!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.135
passages.text: Et rursus miserum, quod me procul inde remoto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.136
passages.text: Quem minime vellem, forsitan alter adest!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.137
passages.text: Ille manus istas effingit, et adsidet aegrae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.138
passages.text: Invisus superis cum superisque mihi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.139
passages.text: Dumque suo temptat salientem pollice venam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.140
passages.text: Candida per causam bracchia saepe tenet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.141
passages.text: Contrectatque sinus, et forsitan oscula iungit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.142
passages.text: Officio merces plenior ista suo est!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.143
passages.text: Quis tibi permisit nostras praecerpere messes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.144
passages.text: Ad saepem alterius quis tibi fecit iter?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.145
passages.text: Iste sinus meus est! mea turpiter oscula sumis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.146
passages.text: A mihi promisso corpore tolle manus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.147
passages.text: Inprobe, tolle manus! quam tangis, nostra futura est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.148
passages.text: Postmodo si facies istud, adulter eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.149
passages.text: Elige de vacuis quam non sibi vindicet alter;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.150
passages.text: Si nescis, dominum res habet ista suum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.151
passages.text: Nec mihi credideris — recitetur formula pacti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.152
passages.text: Neu falsam dicas esse, fac ipsa legat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.153
passages.text: Alterius thalamo, tibi nos, tibi dicimus, exi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.154
passages.text: Quid facis hic? exi! non vacat iste torus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.155
passages.text: Nam quod habes et tu gemini verba altera pacti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.156
passages.text: Non erit idcirco par tua causa meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.157
passages.text: Haec mihi se pepigit, pater hanc tibi, primus ab illa;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.158
passages.text: Sed propior certe quam pater ipsa sibi est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.159
passages.text: Promisit pater hanc, haec se iuravit amanti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.160
passages.text: Ille homines, haec est testificata deam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.161
passages.text: Hic metuit mendax, haec et periura vocari;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.162
passages.text: An dubitas, hic sit maior an ille metus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.163
passages.text: Denique, ut amborum conferre pericula possis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.164
passages.text: Respice ad eventus — haec cubat, ille valet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.165
passages.text: Nos quoque dissimili certamina mente subimus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.166
passages.text: Nec spes par nobis nec timor aequus adest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.167
passages.text: Tu petis ex tuto; gravior mihi morte repulsa est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.168
passages.text: Idque ego iam, quod tu forsan amabis, amo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.169
passages.text: Si tibi iustitiae, si recti cura fuisset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.170
passages.text: Cedere debueras ignibus ipse meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.171
passages.text: Nunc, quoniam ferus hic pro causa pugnat iniqua,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.172
passages.text: Ad quid, Cydippe, littera nostra redit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.173
passages.text: Hic facit ut iaceas et sis suspecta Dianae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.174
passages.text: Hunc tu, si sapias, limen adire vetes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.175
passages.text: Hoc faciente subis tam saeva pericula vitae —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.176
passages.text: Atque utinam pro te, qui movet illa, cadat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.177
passages.text: Quem si reppuleris, nec, quem dea damnat, amaris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.178
passages.text: Tu tunc continuo, certe ego salvus ero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.179
passages.text: Siste metum, virgo! stabili potiere salute,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.180
passages.text: Fac modo polliciti conscia templa colas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.181
passages.text: Non bove mactato caelestia numina gaudent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.182
passages.text: Sed, quae praestanda est et sine teste, fide.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.183
passages.text: Ut valeant aliae, ferrum patiuntur et ignes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.184
passages.text: Fert aliis tristem sucus amarus opem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.185
passages.text: Nil opus est istis; tantum periuria vita

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.186
passages.text: Teque simul serva meque datamque fidem!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.187
passages.text: Praeteritae veniam dabit ignorantia culpae —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.188
passages.text: Exciderant animo foedera lecta tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.189
passages.text: Admonita es modo voce mea cum casibus istis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.190
passages.text: Quos, quotiens temptas fallere, ferre soles.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.191
passages.text: His quoque vitatis in partu nempe rogabis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.192
passages.text: Ut tibi luciferas adferat illa manus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.193
passages.text: Audiet et repetens quae sunt audita requiret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.194
passages.text: Iste tibi de quo coniuge partus eat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.195
passages.text: Promittes votum — scit te promittere falso;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.196
passages.text: Iurabis — scit te fallere posse deos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.197
passages.text: Non agitur de me; cura maiore laboro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.198
passages.text: Anxia sunt causa pectora nostra tua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.199
passages.text: Cur modo te dubiam pavidi flevere parentes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.200
passages.text: Ignaros culpae quos facis esse tuae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.201
passages.text: Et cur ignorent? matri licet omnia narres.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.202
passages.text: Nil tua, Cydippe, facta ruboris habent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.203
passages.text: Ordine fac referas ut sis mihi cognita primum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.204
passages.text: Sacra pharetratae dum facit ipsa deae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.205
passages.text: Ut te conspecta subito, si forte notasti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.206
passages.text: Restiterim fixis in tua membra genis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.207
passages.text: Et, te dum nimium miror, nota certa furoris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.208
passages.text: Deciderint umero pallia lapsa meo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.209
passages.text: Postmodo nescio qua venisse volubile malum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.210
passages.text: Verba ferens doctis insidiosa notis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.211
passages.text: Quod quia sit lectum sancta praesente Diana,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.212
passages.text: Esse tuam vinctam numine teste fidem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.213
passages.text: Ne tamen ignoret, scripti sententia quae sit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.214
passages.text: Lecta tibi quondam nunc quoque verba refer.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.215
passages.text: 'Nube, precor,' dicet, 'cui te bona numina iungunt;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.216
passages.text: Quem fore iurasti, sit gener ille mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.217
passages.text: Quisquis is est, placeat, quoniam placet ante Dianae!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.218
passages.text: Talis erit mater, si modo mater erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.219
passages.text: Sed tamen ut quaerat quis sim qualisque, videto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.220
passages.text: Inveniet vobis consuluisse deam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.221
passages.text: Insula, Coryciis quondam celeberrima nymphis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.222
passages.text: Cingitur Aegaeo, nomine Cea, mari.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.223
passages.text: Illa mihi patria est; nec, si generosa probatis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.224
passages.text: Nomina, despectis arguor ortus avis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.225
passages.text: Sunt et opes nobis, sunt et sine crimine mores;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.226
passages.text: Amplius utque nihil, me tibi iungit Amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.227
passages.text: Appeteres talem vel non iurata maritum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.228
passages.text: Iuratae vel non talis habendus eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.229
passages.text: Haec tibi me in somnis iaculatrix scribere Phoebe;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.230
passages.text: Haec tibi me vigilem scribere iussit Amor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.231
passages.text: E quibus alterius mihi iam nocuere sagittae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.232
passages.text: Alterius noceant ne tibi tela, cave!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.233
passages.text: Iuncta salus nostra est — miserere meique tuique;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.234
passages.text: Quid dubitas unam ferre duobus opem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.235
passages.text: Quod si contigerit, cum iam data signa sonabunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.236
passages.text: Tinctaque votivo sanguine Delos erit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.237
passages.text: Aurea ponetur mali felicis imago,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.238
passages.text: Causaque versiculis scripta duobus erit:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.239
passages.text: Effigie pomi testatur Acontius huius

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.240
passages.text: Quae fuerint in eo scripta fuisse rata.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.241
passages.text: Longior infirmum ne lasset epistula corpus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 20.242
passages.text: Clausaque consueto sit sibi fine: vale!
